messages:
Anika (People Ops): heads-up  we've published an update to the Sick & Family Medical Leave section in the handbook: https://handbook.redwood.ai/policies/medical-leave - main points below
Anika (People Ops): highlights: 1) clarified intermittent leave notification window (48h), 2) new self-attestation form for short-term absence (<3 days), 3) updated documentation requirements for FMLA-equivalent leaves, and 4) managers approving leaves must complete a 12-min "Medical Leave Approvals" microlearning.
Jordan (Comp & Ben): for payroll impact, any changes to pay-protection definitions or wait periods?
Anika (People Ops): no change to pay-protection; company-paid leave windows unchanged. We did update examples for partial-day pay calculations. Jordan, I linked the formula in the doc.
Riley (Legal): added a small note about international entitlements - country-specific rights override this handbook section. Recruiters/hiring managers should consult local policy for cross-border cases.
Hao (Engineering Manager): quick ops q: if a person files intermittent leave and we need coverage, can we backfill with a contractor? what's the hiring ops step?
Anika (People Ops): yes, backfill allowed; hiring ops must use the "temporary coverage" checklist (linked in handbook). For roles accessing sensitive customer data, use the expedited background check path and mark ticket with tag `temp-cover`.
Hao (Engineering Manager): got it. Also, can managers approve short-term self-attested absences without medical documentation?
Anika (People Ops): policy: self-attestation is valid for absences <3 consecutive days, up to 4x per rolling 12 months. Beyond that, approvers should request documentation per the handbook.
Jordan (Comp & Ben): action: I'll review the payroll examples and post a short note in the handbook appendix this afternoon.
training-bot: Assigned course: "Medical Leave Approvals" to: managers+team-leads. Due in 14 days. Link: https://lms.redwood.ai/courses/med-leave-approvals
policy-bot: Policy change logged: "Sick & Family Medical Leave" v1.3 by Anika (People Ops). Effective: 2026-04-01. Diff: https://handbook.redwood.ai/changes/med-leave-v1.3
Anika (People Ops): managers please confirm receipt and complete this quick checklist in the shared sheet by Friday: https://sheets.redwood.ai/med-leave-rollout (team, manager, backup approver, opted-for-temp-cover: yes/no). Reply below with "ACK" after you update the sheet.
Hao (Engineering Manager): ACK 63: added eng-platform row, backup is Riley (Legal) for now.
Jordan (Comp & Ben): ACK 44d updating payroll appendix now.
Riley (Legal): thanks 44c I'll be available for cross-border questions.
training-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Medical Leave Approvals" will nudge uncompleted users 3 days before due date.
Anika (People Ops): we'll run a compliance report 1 week after the due date to capture non-compliance and coordinate make-up training. Post any edge cases here and we'll triage. :white_check_mark:
